leave_sick_days_001.evidence: Every teacher shall have ten (10) sick leave days during his/her first year in the system and eight (8) days sick leave each year thereafter.

leave_sick_accrual_002.evidence: A teacher may accumulate unused sick leave without limit, which accumulated leave shall be used for sick leave purposes only.

leave_sick_family_003.evidence: In any given year, seven (7) of such days may be used due to illness of any member of the teacher's immediate family (as defined in Article III, Section 2).

leave_personal_days_004.evidence: Each teacher shall annually be granted three (3) days for personal leave.

leave_personal_restrictions_005.answer: May be taken in increments of not less than one-half day; no reason required other than personal business.
leave_personal_restrictions_005.evidence: These days shall be used for any purpose at the discretion of the teacher and may be taken in time periods of not less than one-half (½) days. No reason must be given other than personal business.

leave_personal_conversion_006.evidence: Unused personal leave days shall be added to accumulated sick leave at the end of the school year up to the maximum for sick leave accumulation. However, if a teacher has an attendance record of 97% or higher... permitted to carry over and accumulate unused personal days up to a maximum of four (4) personal leave days, and any unused personal leave days beyond the four (4) shall be added to accumulated sick leave.
